segments.name: Online retail (e-commerce)
segments.description: Online retailer that resells wholesale-purchased products to U.S. consumers, primarily as a third-party seller on Amazon.
segments.evidence: Segment Information – We only have one segment, which is online retail (e-commerce).

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling wholesale-purchased products to customers on Amazon, Walmart and its own website, paying platform fees to Amazon and Walmart.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell merchandise on Amazon and the sales are fulfilled by Amazon. We pay Amazon fees for allowing us to sell on their platform.
